adjudication.rationale: In sync mode, `refreshOAuthTokens` explicitly allows returning a response that “should only contain the access token and expiry date” (no `refresh_token`) when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set. `packages/app-store/webex/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts` was changed to use `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`, but unlike several other integrations in this diff (e.g., Zoom/Office365/Google) it does not apply `parseRefreshTokenResponse` or otherwise guard against a missing `refresh_token`. If the existing Webex adapter logic persists the refreshed token payload into `credential.key` (as these adapters typically do), a sync-mode response lacking `refresh_token` would result in losing/overwriting the stored refresh token, breaking future refreshes.
